actions.title: Confirm the private lesson boundary
actions.instruction: Read the Preview 0.12 release limits before using any command. U01 is a private source contract, so the installed Academy verifier does not prepare, reset, or Check it.
actions.rationale: The course must not make a partially verified lab look runnable simply because its source guide exists.
actions.expected_result: You know that no U01 attempt can be created through the public Preview 0.12 verifier.
actions.recovery: If you expected a runnable Academy lab, return to P08 or another published lesson. Do not bypass the publication boundary by editing release data.
actions.evidence: The Preview manifest excludes U01 from available, runnable, and guided labs.

actions.title: Inspect the prepared scenario only when it exists
actions.instruction: Use one command surface to inspect the scenario file. A native terminal command has no !. A harness shell command begins with exactly one !. If the path is absent, stop: public Preview 0.12 cannot prepare this private scenario.
actions.rationale: The scenario declares the bounded target, approval-required starting condition, and the future operator-guide evidence without claiming that the current public toolchain installed it.
actions.expected_result: A maintainer-prepared attempt shows autonomous_sprint, academy-sprint, approval-required, and docs/academy-sprint-summary.md. A public Preview 0.12 checkout normally reports that the file is absent.
actions.recovery: Do not create the scenario file by hand. Preserve the missing-path result and return to the private publication decision.
actions.evidence: When preparation is available, retain the scenario file, U01-sprint-brief.json, and its attempt branch name.

actions.title: Observe the unavailable Prepare boundary
actions.instruction: These are the installed Academy Prepare commands that a published U01 would use. Do not expect them to create an attempt in Preview 0.12. Run one only when you need to confirm the current public boundary.
actions.rationale: The TUI remains a setup and recovery helper. It must fail closed for a lesson that has not reached public acceptance.
actions.expected_result: The command reports that U01 is not published or guided. It creates no numbered attempt and changes no repository state.
actions.recovery: Keep the error output if you are auditing the boundary. Do not substitute repository-local source execution for the installed public authority.
actions.evidence: The refusal and an unchanged git status show that the public verifier did not prepare U01.

actions.title: Use the host-native sprint command only on a private prepared attempt
actions.instruction: On a maintainer-supplied private prepared attempt, run this CodeArbiter command in the selected harness. It is not a shell command, so it never begins with !. Do not run it against an ordinary checkout or use it to skip the sprint specification approval gate.
actions.rationale: An autonomous sprint may execute after its specification gate, but it cannot self-authorize the scope of an Academy exercise.
actions.expected_result: The host enters its sprint specification gate and presents the proposed scope before autonomous work begins.
actions.recovery: If the host cannot find the sprint command, do not replace it with shell syntax. Confirm the supported host installation and private attempt first.
actions.evidence: Preserve the proposed specification, derived plan, operator guide, and appended sprint-log decision record. The future source Check validates repository facts, not host invocation.

actions.title: Make the sprint specification decision
actions.instruction: Read the proposed specification before answering the host. Approve only the bounded academy-sprint operator guide with explicit acceptance criteria and no product-code, test, dependency, push, or network work. Decline or revise vague scope.
actions.rationale: The learner, not the autonomous process, owns the scope decision that permits later execution.
actions.expected_result: The host either records an explicit approved specification and proceeds, or stops with the requested revision still visible.
actions.recovery: If the proposal changes boundaries you did not intend, decline it. Preserve the proposal and begin a fresh private attempt only after the scenario owner corrects the training contract.
actions.evidence: The source Check inspects the prepared brief, final spec, plan, guide, append-only log, exact commit paths, and clean worktree. It does not verify the approval itself.

actions.title: Inspect the governed artifact paths
actions.instruction: On a private prepared attempt after the sprint has stopped or completed, inspect the four named artifact paths in a native terminal. This is an observation command, so it has no !.
actions.rationale: The verifier-owned evidence boundary is explicit before the lesson becomes publicly runnable.
actions.expected_result: A completed private exercise exposes the spec, plan, append-only sprint log, and operator guide for review. Their presence alone is not a passing result.
actions.recovery: If any artifact is absent or the worktree is not the private prepared attempt, stop. Do not create substitute files to imitate evidence.
actions.evidence: Retain the paths and review result. The source predicate also requires their scope, one commit, preserved log prefix, and a clean worktree.

actions.title: Observe the unavailable Check boundary
actions.instruction: These are the installed Academy Check commands. In Preview 0.12 they refuse U01 because it is not published. The reviewed source profile is positive only for the bounded four-artifact packet described by this lesson.
actions.rationale: The installed release must fail closed until it carries the reviewed sprint-evidence contract.
actions.expected_result: The command reports that U01 is not published. It cannot record progress until an installed release includes the accepted source predicate.
actions.recovery: Do not retry by editing progress data, release data, or sprint artifacts. Preserve the refusal and wait for an Academy release that includes U01.
actions.evidence: No public U01 progress record exists. The accepted source evidence is the bounded predicate and its adversarial tests.

actions.title: Return to main only after the private attempt is clean
actions.instruction: On a clean private attempt, return to main from a native terminal. This is a direct shell command, so it has no !.
actions.rationale: Leaving evidence intact keeps an incomplete training run inspectable without treating it as public completion.
actions.expected_result: git status --short prints nothing before main becomes the active branch.
actions.recovery: If status shows changes, stop and inspect them. Do not discard, amend, rebase, force-update, or delete the attempt branch to make it look clean.
actions.evidence: The numbered attempt remains reachable for later predicate design and review.

actions.title: Observe the unavailable Reset boundary
actions.instruction: These are the installed Academy Reset commands. They are documented so the future published lesson has an explicit recovery surface, but Preview 0.12 correctly refuses this private lab.
actions.rationale: Reset must preserve a failed attempt and create a numbered retry only after a public Academy release includes the accepted U01 verifier contract.
actions.expected_result: The command reports that U01 is not published and preserves existing repository state.
actions.recovery: Do not simulate Reset with destructive Git commands. Wait for the public release that packages the U01 fixture and verifier.
actions.evidence: The public refusal leaves no new attempt branch and no altered progress record.
